channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PT minimiza pressão contra Wagner e foca na presunção de inocência
item.description: Pedro Uczai, leader of the PT in the Chamber of Deputies, defended the presumption of innocence of Senate government leader Jaques Wagner amid PF investigations into alleged frauds at Banco Master, stating the party does not pressure for his removal and that the decision rests with President Lula. Uczai also supported establishing a CPMI on Banco Master and emphasized the need for investigative autonomy.

item.title: Departamento de Estado dos EUA sai em defesa de Eduardo após condenação pelo STF
item.description: The U.S. Department of Defense defended Eduardo Bolsonaro, stating that his conviction by Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (STF) for coercion reflects a pattern of persecution and 'lawfare' by Brazilian courts against political opposition. The statement followed Eduardo's condemnation by the STF. The case has sparked international debate over judicial independence and political polarization in Brazil.

item.title: PGR diverge da AGU e defende validade da lei que reduz a pena de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) defended the constitutionality of the Dosimetry Law, which reduces the penalty for Jair Bolsonaro, diverging from the position of the Office of the Attorney General of the Union (AGU), which considers the norm unconstitutional and requests its suspension by the STF. The conflict between the two federal executive bodies occurs amid debates over the law’s application in cases against the former president.

item.title: Imprensa internacional destaca relação entre Wagner e Lula
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), the government leader in the Senate, as part of the investigation into Banco Master. The action gained international attention, with media outlets from four countries highlighting Wagner’s close ties to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, amplifying the political impact of the financial scandal.

item.title: Jaques Wagner já rebateu acusações de Flávio sobre Master: ‘gênese foi no governo Bolsonaro’
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) rebutted Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) accusations regarding Banco Master, stating its origins lie in the Bolsonaro government, not Bahia, citing approval by the Central Bank under Campos Neto. He also criticized the hypocrisy of lawmakers claiming honesty, referencing intercepted messages between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro. Wagner further noted his role in the privatization of Ebal and Credcesta, which later became key assets of Banco Pleno and were transferred to Master.

item.title: Flávio nega influência de Eduardo em tarifas contra o Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) denied that his brother, Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL), influenced the U.S. imposition of tariffs against Brazil. In an interview with Jovem Pan News, he stated that Eduardo only supported the application of the Magnitsky Act against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, with no connection to the American tariff measures.

item.title: Flávio diz que origem do caso Master está no PT da Bahia
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Bahia PT of being the core of the Banco Master investigations, claiming the scheme originated in the state party and that its leadership fears a CPI. He also claimed the PT resists a CPMI because it has something to hide, despite Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) having signed the inquiry request and denied any ties to Banco Master or Credcesta.

item.title: Operação contra Jaques Wagner repercute na imprensa internacional, que destaca proximidade com Lula
item.description: International media highlighted the Federal Police operation targeting Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) over alleged links to the Banco Master scandal, emphasizing his close ties to President Lula. Outlets such as DW, Bloomberg, El País, and Clarín drew parallels to past corruption schemes like Operation Car Wash, underscoring the political significance for the Brazilian government.

item.title: Incerteza, política e poder às big techs: a nova regulamentação das redes no Brasil
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler criticizes the STF's new regulation amending Brazil's Internet Civil Framework, which shifts responsibility to big techs to remove content upon judicial order. He warns this delegates censorship power to platforms, enabling them to suppress political speech—such as protests against the Court or criticism of electronic voting—via algorithms and AI, turning what was once a critique of social media into official policy.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz que dinheiro apreendido pela PF em endereço ligado a ele veio de diárias do Senado e foi declarado
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) stated that the cash seized by the Federal Police in locations linked to him — including $49,000 in cash at a Brasília hotel and additional amounts in euros and dollars in Salvador — originated from undeclared Senate travel allowances for official trips that were not used and were properly reported. He denied any involvement with Banco Master, affirmed he is not a defendant or accused in any related investigation, and said he remains fully cooperative with authorities. The operation, the ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, was authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, who identified Wagner as the 'central beneficiary' of economic advantages paid by Banco Master in exchange for his congressional actions favoring the bank.

item.title: Nunes Marques diz que discurso de ódio é incompatível com a democracia
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that hate speech is incompatible with democracy during the opening of the court's session on the International Day for Countering Hate Speech. He emphasized that while ideological disagreement is legitimate, it must not be confused with attacks on honor, discrimination, or attempts to dehumanize political opponents, as intolerance restricts civic participation and increases the risk of political violence. The minister reaffirmed the TSE's commitment to free, safe, and inclusive elections, and noted he was randomly selected as rapporteur in a criminal complaint filed by Flávio Bolsonaro against Lula, alleging hate speech regarding 'traitors of the homeland'.

item.title: Governo teve dificuldade para se distanciar do Master no início do ano e ação sobre Wagner renova riscos
item.description: The Lula government faces the risk of being associated again with the Master scandal, despite efforts to shift blame to the opposition using the 'BolsoMaster' slogan. Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Senator Jaques Wagner, has revived fears that the public may link the executive to Daniel Vorcaro's bank scheme. Meanwhile, the government emphasizes its respect for institutions, but the opposition seeks to rekindle the connection between Lula and the scandal on social media.

item.title: A estratégia de Lula para manter o caso Master no colo de Flávio Bolsonaro pós Jaques Wagner
item.description: The Federal Police revealed that Senator Jaques Wagner, Lula's government leader, was a central beneficiary of economic advantages paid by members of Banco Master. Despite this finding, Lula's communication strategy for the 2026 election is not expected to change, maintaining the focus on attributing the Master case to Flávio Bolsonaro. The subscriber-only article suggests the government avoids repositioning its narrative in light of the new development.

item.title: Jaques Wagner diz que dólares apreendidos pela PF são de diárias do Senado e que Lula prestou solidariedade após operação
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), leader of Lula’s government in the Senate, stated that the U.S. dollars seized by the Federal Police in the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero originated from Senate-paid daily allowances for his international travels between 2019 and 2026, amounting to approximately US$70,000. He denied any connection with Daniel Vorcaro or Banco Master and said President Lula called him to express solidarity and claim efforts to destabilize him. Wagner affirmed he remains calm, fully cooperative with justice, and will maintain his pre-candidacy for Senate re-election.

item.title: Programa de Flávio contra o crime organizado não cita combate à corrupção e à infiltração no Estado
item.description: The article criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro's plan to combat organized crime for ignoring police corruption and criminal infiltration of the state, noting that proposals like building more federal prisons already exist and are ineffective without addressing corruption. It emphasizes that effective action against organized crime requires confronting public officials' collusion, as shown by recent cases of police involved in executions and trafficking schemes.

item.title: Polícia Civil pede autorização de Moraes para intimar Bolsonaro em inquérito sobre arma
item.description: The Civil Police of the Federal District requested authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to summon Jair Bolsonaro via videoconference on June 24 at 3 p.m. in an investigation concerning a firearm found with a military officer. The weapon, a 9mm Glock pistol, was seized in Taguatinga after an Army sergeant stated he received it from Bolsonaro for maintenance. Bolsonaro’s defense claims the transfer was solely for diagnosing and repairing a malfunction.

item.title: Não acho que Lula fará isso, diz Jaques Wagner sobre sair da liderança do governo
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), leader of Lula’s government in the Senate, said he will remain in office unless the president decides otherwise, despite being a target of the PF’s Operation Compliance Zero. He denied any illicit involvement with Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro and reaffirmed his 2026 re-election bid on Jerônimo Rodrigues’ ticket. Wagner noted that Lula called him to express support and confidence, citing their over-40-year relationship.

item.title: Bastidores: Ação contra Wagner respinga em Lula, mas Planalto vê dano menor que o de Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police operation targeting Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), Lula's Senate leader, is causing political damage to the PT, as Planalto aides believe the case shifts part of the Banco Master scandal's burden onto Lula, though they assess the harm as lesser than Flávio Bolsonaro's direct ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro. While Flávio is heard calling Vorcaro 'brother' in conversations, Lula has no proven personal involvement, but the PT's association with corruption is likely to be strengthened by cases involving his close allies.

item.title: Paulo Pimenta diz confiar na inocência de Jaques Wagner no caso Master
item.description: Paulo Pimenta, the government leader in the Chamber of Deputies, expressed confidence in the innocence of Jaques Wagner, the government leader in the Senate, who is a target of the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police, investigating alleged irregularities involving Banco Master and public officials. He emphasized the autonomy of the PF and the right to defense, while the PT Senate caucus and national party president Edinho Silva backed Wagner, stating he will provide all necessary clarifications.

item.title: Marconi Perillo lidera disputa ao governo de Goiás, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Exata.GO conducted from June 8 to 13, 2026, shows former governor Marconi Perillo (PSDB) leading the race for governor of Goiás with 33.81% voting intention, followed by current governor Daniel Vilela (MDB) at 28.47% and senator Wilder Morais (PL) at 8.78%. The poll interviewed 3,600 respondents, has a margin of error of ±1.63 percentage points, and is registered with the TSE under code GO-07683/2026.

item.title: Flávio lança plano de segurança com castração química e presídios no modelo Bukele
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) launched his public security plan 'Brazil Without Fear', containing 12 measures, including chemical castration for criminals and the adoption of prisons modeled after El Salvador's approach under Nayib Bukele. The event took place in São Paulo's Faria Lima district, positioning the pre-candidate for president as a hardline advocate against crime.

item.title: Avaliação no governo sobre impacto da operação que atingiu Jaques Wagner
item.description: The government's assessment is that the operation targeting Jaques Wagner, the government leader in the Senate, lacks the same electoral impact as the operation that affected Flávio Bolsonaro. Despite Wagner's strategic position in Congress, the action against him is seen as less relevant to the 2026 electoral landscape. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: El escándalo del Banco Master en Brasil golpea a un líder del Partido de los Trabajadores cercano a Lula
item.description: Brazil's Federal Police is investigating Senator Jaques Wagner, a close ally of President Lula and PT leader in the Senate, for allegedly receiving an apartment as a bribe from Banco Master, a financial institution liquidated in late 2025 over a massive fraud scheme. The operation on Thursday included 18 search and seizure warrants, including at the hotel where Wagner resides. The scandal adds political pressure to the PT, coming weeks after similar controversies affected right-wing figures like Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Após baque nas pesquisas, campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro ganha nova arma contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign found relief in the Federal Police operation against Senator Jaques Wagner, Lula’s Senate leader, as PL allies believe the investigation creates a political equivalence between government and opposition, easing the fallout from the Banco Master scandal. The goal is to reverse recent investigative focus on Bolsonaro allies by shifting scrutiny onto Lula’s government.

item.title: Presidente do PT-BA reage a operação contra Jaques Wagner: “Vida de retidão”
item.description: The president of the PT in Bahia, Tassio Brito, defended Senator Jaques Wagner following the 9th phase of the PF's 'Compliance Zero' operation, stating that Wagner has a lifetime of public integrity and that investigations will confirm his actions were within the law. Brito also denied that Wagner requested 134 million reais from anyone, referencing an audio of Flávio Bolsonaro, and argued that the real focus of the Banco Master scandal lies in Lula’s administration, when the Central Bank liquidated the institution.

item.title: Cientista político avalia o dano potencial para Lula da ação da PF contra líder do governo
item.description: Political scientist Rodrigo Prando warns that the PF operation targeting Senate government leader Senator Jaques Wagner could cause political damage to Lula’s reelection pre-campaign, depending on how far the investigation progresses. He notes the opposition will try to link the case to the Lula government, while PT allies may shift blame to prior administrations, but real wear is possible if the probe reaches the president directly. The government’s initial response — such as Wagner’s temporary removal — will be key to limiting electoral fallout.

item.title: As “ressalvas” do TCESP nas contas de Tarcísio às vésperas da eleição
item.description: The São Paulo State Court of Accounts approved Tarcísio de Freitas’ 2025 financial accounts but issued significant reservations regarding transparency and fiscal management. The report highlights the concentration of tax benefits — where 1% of companies receive 80% of all exemptions — and notes that tax renouncements surpassed public investments between 2020 and 2023, projected to reach R$93.7 billion by 2026. It also warns about inadequate oversight of third-sector concessions and orders the government to submit a corrective action plan within 90 days.

item.title: PEC 6×1 entra em compasso de espera no Senado
item.description: The PEC proposing the end of the 6×1 work schedule is on hold in the Senate, awaiting a political agreement between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The delay aims to avoid the Senate being seen as merely rubber-stamping a popular measure or opposing a sensitive issue for workers. Leaders are discussing a gradual process, including public hearings and possible incorporation of alternative proposals, to reduce the political cost of the decision.

item.title: No Senado, Wagner justificou venda de consignado da Bahia a Augusto Lima: ‘Era uma excrescência’
item.description: Jaques Wagner, Senate government leader, defended the privatization of the Bahian Food Company (Ebal) and the transfer of the Credcesta card to Banco Master, calling the state-owned supermarket chain an 'excrescency' with annual losses of R$ 80 million. He denied ongoing involvement in the scheme, framing the privatization as a liberal policy and attempting to link the Banco Master scandal to Flávio Bolsonaro, citing messages between Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The remarks were made on May 13 during a deliberative session, the same day Intercept Brasil published a report on those message exchanges.

item.title: Gilmar propõe súmula para barrar leis sem estudo de impacto fiscal
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes proposed a binding summary (súmula) requiring pre-legislative fiscal impact studies for any law creating mandatory expenses or revenue loss, grounded in Article 113 of the ADCT. The initiative aims to block 'fiscal time bombs' with an estimated annual impact of R$111 billion, such as the PEC on retirement for health agents. Finance Minister Dario Durigan debated the issue with judges following Lula government meetings with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to seek restraint on voting fiscally contentious measures.

item.title: “É por essa que pessoa que Lula se sente representado?”, diz Zema sobre Wagner
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized President Lula (PT) by associating him with Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), who was targeted in a Federal Police operation on Thursday (18). Zema questioned whether Lula feels represented by Wagner, implying a negative connection between the two. The statement was made amid rising political tension between the opposition and the government.

item.title: PT quer insistir em discurso sobre Master contra Flávio e tenta diferenciar Lula de Jaques
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign is still assessing the impact of the operation against government leader Senator Jaques Wagner, linked to the Master bank, but insists on maintaining the discourse about Daniel Vorcaro's frauds against Flávio Bolsonaro to differentiate Lula's image from Wagner's.

item.title: Aliados de Lula no Congresso e no Planalto defendem que Jaques Wagner entregue liderança no Senado e veem 'constrangimento'
item.description: Lula’s allies in Congress and the Planalto are urging Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) to step down as Senate government leader following a Federal Police investigation into alleged improper benefits from Banco Master, citing embarrassment and risks to the government’s image and Lula’s re-election campaign. Despite public support from figures like PT president Edinho Silva and the Senate PT bloc, officials say his continued presence is 'practically unsustainable' and expect him to resign voluntarily to deny ammunition to the opposition. The final decision rests with Lula, who shares a long-standing relationship with Wagner, but faces pressure to uphold the narrative linking the Banco Master scandal to the right and centrão.

item.title: “Discurso de Ódio ameaça a democracia”, afirma presidente do TSE
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that hate speech is incompatible with democracy and threatens citizen participation, highlighting the International Day for Combating Hate Speech. He emphasized that freedom of expression must be exercised responsibly and that combating hate speech protects democracy and ensures everyone can participate in public life without fear or discrimination.

item.title: Flávio apresenta plano para a segurança; leia as 12 medidas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) unveiled the 'Brazil without Fear' public security plan, comprising 12 measures to combat organized crime, toughen criminal legislation, and increase federal investment in security. Key proposals include classifying criminal factions as narco-terrorist organizations, lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16, building new federal prisons modeled after El Salvador’s system, implementing chemical castration for rapists, and establishing a national facial recognition system.

item.title: Para Zema, ação contra Jaques não surpreende: "Se gritar pega ladrão…"
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president from the Novo party, commented on the PF's Operation Compliance Zero, stating that the inclusion of Jaques Wagner does not surprise him, claiming the Bahia PT is complicit in the Banco Master scandal, not a victim. He emphasized that Wagner, Lula's Senate leader, is being 'framed' over alleged ties to the bank, including benefits such as a R$ 2.5 million apartment and other perks.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que operação contra Jaques Wagner é 'alento'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) described the Federal Police operation against Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) as 'encouraging' during an event on Thursday (18). Wagner, leader of the Lula government in the Senate, was one of the targets of the new phase of Operation Compliance Zero. The statement was made amid political tensions between Bolsonaro's allies and members of the federal government.

item.title: Jaques Wagner tem nossa confiança e 'esclarecerá todos os fatos', diz presidente do PT
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, defended Senator Jaques Wagner after he became a target of the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police, which investigates a billion-dollar fraud and corruption scheme linked to Banco Master. Edinho expressed full confidence in Wagner, stating he will 'clarify all the facts' and prove his innocence. The PT also linked the scandal to the Bolsonaro government, claiming the Bolsonaro family received benefits from the scheme.

item.title: Ministro da Fazenda defende que PEC do fim da escala 6x1 seja votada no Senado nos moldes da Câmara
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan advocated for the Senate to vote on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule in the exact form approved by the Chamber, without adding other topics such as flexible work. He stated that the Chamber’s version is a good text and should be voted on promptly, warning that delaying it to include further debates could risk losing momentum on an issue with public support. Durigan said he would not close the door to discussing other topics later, such as the role of collective bargaining in labor regulation.

item.title: 'O cerne de todo esse problema era o PT da Bahia', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após operação contra Jaques Wagner
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praised the Federal Police operation targeting Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), Lula’s government leader in the Senate, claiming the root of corruption lies in Bahia’s PT. Wagner was identified as the central beneficiary of economic advantages from Banco Master, including a R$ 2.45 million apartment and aircraft use. Flávio, who also had ties to the bank, sought to link the PT to the scheme to deflect scrutiny from his own controversies.

item.title: São Luís amplia presença internacional com o Meeting Brasil
item.description: São Luís is strengthening its international tourism presence through participation in Meeting Brasil Europa 2026 and Meeting Brasil América Latina 2026. The city highlights its historic center, Portuguese-tiled architecture, São João festival, gastronomy, popular culture, and afrotourism, particularly the Quilombo Cultural Route. The strategy aims to convert its cultural identity into a commercially viable tourism product for international operators.

item.title: Caso Master: Lula vai adotar discurso de que PF é independente e faz seu trabalho, doa a quem doer
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) in the Banco Master case, threatening to involve the Lula government in a corruption scandal. Despite PT pressure to defend Wagner, Lula seeks to distance himself by asserting the PF acts with independence, repeating the 'do a quem doer' rhetoric used in investigations against his son Fábio Luís. Wagner, a close ally of Lula, denies the allegations and claims he will prove his innocence, while the government attempts to isolate the scandal to the Centrão and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Governo teme que ação contra líder de Lula esvazie efeito de revelações sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula's allies warn that the Federal Police operation against Senate government leader Jaques Wagner could be exploited by Flávio Bolsonaro as a defense against allegations tied to his conversations with Daniel Vorcaro regarding funding for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The government fears the action against Wagner may undermine the impact of revelations about Bolsonaro's son.

item.title: “O PT da Bahia acaba de ser implodido pela PF”, reage Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed that the Federal Police's Operation Compliance Zero 'imploded' the Bahia PT by targeting Senate government leader Jaques Wagner, calling it a sign that impunity will be fought. He linked the operation to an alleged scheme involving Banco Master and called it a 'bad day' for allies like Derrite and Moro, as well as for criminal factions and the PT. The event in São Paulo unveiled his 'Brazil Without Fear' security plan, featuring 12 measures focused on combating organized crime.

item.title: Sem acordo entre líderes, Alcolumbre adia análise de vetos de Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre postponed a joint congressional session to review President Lula’s vetoes and additional credit bills for the 2026 budget due to lack of agreement among party leaders. He said negotiations will resume next week, with a new session planned in 10 to 15 days, regardless of whether a voting slate is agreed upon.

item.title: Alcolumbre cancela sessão do Congresso após operação da PF que mira relação de Jaques Wagner com Master
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre canceled the joint congressional session due to low expected quorum and to avoid accusations of bias, pledging to call a new session within 15 days. The move followed a Federal Police operation targeting Jaques Wagner, the government's Senate leader, in the ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, investigating alleged economic benefits tied to Banco Master, including the seizure of R$253,000 in cash.

item.title: Planalto e PT esperam que Wagner faça gesto de entregar liderança do governo para blindar campanha de Lula
item.description: The Planalto and the PT expect Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) to resign as Senate government leader following a PF operation investigating his ties to ex-banker Augusto Lima and Banco Master. The move aims to shield Lula’s 2026 campaign, as the probe examines whether Wagner acted in favor of the financial group’s interests, including the so-called 'Master Amendment'. Despite the PT’s official support for his innocence, there is pressure for Wagner to voluntarily step down, as anticipated by Lula’s allies.

item.title: Nova operação do Master vira ringue virtual; veja a repercussão de aliados do governo e da oposição
item.description: The ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero targeted Senate government leader Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), sparking a narrative battle between government allies, who defend his innocence and support the investigations, and the opposition, which views the case as evidence of systemic corruption. While PT president Edinho Silva and Finance Minister Dario Durigan expressed confidence in Wagner’s defense, opposition senators Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Sérgio Moro (PL-PR) criticized the PT and linked the case to an alleged corruption scheme in the federal government.

item.title: Ministros esperam que Jaques Wagner entregue liderança, mas Lula ainda não tomou decisão
item.description: Palácio do Planalto ministers expect Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) to relinquish government leadership following his inclusion in a Police Federal operation investigating the Banco Master scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro. President Lula has not yet made a decision on the matter, creating anticipation and uncertainty within the administration.

item.title: Flávio propõe castração química de estupradores, redução de maioridade penal e presídios inspirados em El Salvador
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) unveiled his public security plan titled 'Brasil sem Medo', proposing chemical castration for rapists, lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 14 for murder and drug trafficking, and building maximum-security prisons modeled after El Salvador’s system. The announcement, made in São Paulo with backing from Sérgio Moro and Guilherme Derrite, criticized the Lula government and responded to rising voter concerns about violence, which now surpasses global averages as a top electoral issue.
